title: Tire Pressure Slow Leak Trend
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:pid metric=tire_pressure
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(front_left_psi) as fl, avg(front_right_psi) as fr, avg(rear_left_psi) as rl, avg(rear_right_psi) as rr by vin _time
| eval avg_psi=round((fl+fr+rl+rr)/4,1)
| sort 0 vin _time
| streamstats current=f last(avg_psi) as prev_avg by vin
| eval delta=round(avg_psi-coalesce(prev_avg,avg_psi),1)
| where delta<-2
| sort delta
description: Looks for day-over-day drops in average tire pressure so you catch a slow leak before it graduates into a roadside inconvenience.
value: TPMS warnings fire late by design; a trend-based leak detector gives you time to top up or inspect a tire before safety or efficiency suffers.
implementation: Load OBD-II tire-pressure snapshots daily; schedule a check for any sustained downward pressure move.
visualization: Trend chart of average tire pressure with day-over-day change markers.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when one of your tires is slowly losing air over a few days instead of all at once.
